name: qa-agentic-pipeline
description: Agentic QA pipeline for Claude Code: four agents turn a spec (URL, text, or PDF) into a gap report with a numbered requirements inventory, a risk-based test plan, test cases split by pyramid level, autotests in your repo's own stack, and an independent review — with one human checkpoint for disputed calls. Output in English or Russian. Progress persists to a Jira-style task file, so a dropped session resumes where it stopped.
